article.story: BOILING SPRINGS, N.C. -- — Cameron Grant’s 24 points helped UNC Greensboro defeat Gardner-Webb 78-72 on Wednesday. Grant also had 15 rebounds and three steals for the Spartans (3-2). Dionte Neal scored 16 points, shooting 4 for 12 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line. R.J. Greer had 12 points and shot 3 for 8 (3 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. Seth Brown led the way for the Runnin’ Bulldogs (1-4) with 22 points. Gardner-Webb also got 15 points and seven rebounds from Jamias Ferere. Mikhail Pocknett finished with 10 points. Up next Both teams next play Saturday. UNC Greensboro hosts South Carolina Upstate and Gardner-Webb goes on the road to play VMI. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
